## Service: surveys (Surveys API)

Documentation for surveys API

### Get Surveys
GET /surveys/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/surveys/
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/surveys/get-surveys | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/surveys/get-surveys.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: surveys.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT")
- skip number (e.g. 0)
- limit number (default: 10; e.g. 20) - Limit Per Page records count. will allow maximum up to 50 and default will be 10
- type string (e.g. "folder")

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- surveys object[]
  - id string
  - name string
  - locationId string
- total number - Number of surveys

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### Get Surveys Submissions
GET /surveys/submissions
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/surveys/submissions
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/surveys/get-surveys-submissions | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/surveys/get-surveys-submissions.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: surveys.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT")
- page number (default: 1) - Page No. By default it will be 1
- limit number (default: 20) - Limit Per Page records count. will allow maximum up to 100 and default will be 20
- surveyId string (e.g. "jjusM6EOngDExnbo2DbU") - Filter submission by survey id
- q string (e.g. "john@deo.com") - Filter by contactId, name, email or phone no.
- startAt string (e.g. "2020-11-14") - Get submission by starting of this date. By default it will be same date of last month(YYYY-MM-DD).
- endAt string (e.g. "2020-12-14") - Get submission by ending of this date. By default it will be current date(YYYY-MM-DD).

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- submissions object[]
  - id string
  - contactId string
  - createdAt string
  - surveyId string
  - name string
  - email string
  - others object
    - __submissions_other_field__ string
    - __custom_field_id__ string
    - eventData object
      - fbc string
      - fbp string
      - page object
        - url string
        - title string
      - type string
      - domain string
      - medium string
      - source string
      - version string
      - adSource string
      - mediumId string
      - parentId string
      - referrer string
      - fbEventId string
      - timestamp number
      - parentName string
      - fingerprint string
      - pageVisitType string
      - contactSessionIds object (nullable)
        - ids string[] (nullable)
    - fieldsOriSequance string[]
- meta object
  - total number
  - currentPage number
  - nextPage number (nullable)
  - prevPage number (nullable)

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
